_comment: LITE API V1'S CONFORMANCE SUITE (docs/records/lite-api-v1-2026-11-17.md §5, the user's go of 2026-11-17): one set of cases every binding answers alike -- the browser's exports (core's LiteApiConformanceTest), the server's /api/lite/v1 routes (the TS host's reader) and Python's native entries (the Python session's reader). A case is an operation (§2's name), its request, and its 'answer' (exact JSON) or 'answerIncludes' (each key it names equal, recursively; each array item it names matched by some item of the answer's array). A refusal case names its 'refusal' as {kind} alone (§3: the kind is the contract; the words are the product's), answered as the binding's error shape. The run's parameter cases are query/run's, the server's and Python's (§4). A case may name its 'bindings' (of browser, server, python; every binding when absent): an operation a host alone serves (user, query/run) names the hosts that serve it, and a binding without it skips the case. Where the answer is the host's own (who the user is), a case gives 'answerShape': each key the answer holds and its JSON type (string, number, boolean, object, array).

cases.name: a query's text, parsed to its tree
an Integer is an exact JSON number, 2^63-1 kept (ruled 7)
a query printed, pretty by default
a query printed, standard
a query typed over its model: each column's Pure type
an Integer value typed
a query planned: lite's plan, data
a model that compiles has no errors
a model's every error, each its kind, message and where

errors.message: [1:1] Unknown type: 'Strin' is not a known primitive, class, or enum

cases.name: a model's elements
a text that does not parse is refused, kind parse
a request holding a key the operation does not read is refused, kind request
a request lacking a key the operation reads is refused, kind request
a style no query prints in is refused, kind request
a model that does not compile is refused when a query is typed over it, kind compile
a query's tree nested deeper than 64 is read (a grid's query nests so; the request's depth is the server's, 4096)
a Decimal column typed by its plain path, its precision and scale no part of the name
the current user: who the store keeps saved queries for, a name
a user request holding a key is refused, kind request
a DECIMAL(10,2) column planned: its type the plain path, its digits data (decimal), its slot and store the database's
a computed decimal planned: its type the plain path, the compiler's digits data (Decimal(38,18)), whatever the database's slot
a query run over a model's own Data rows: its typed rows, in the caller's format (json)
a query/run in a format it has not is refused, kind request
